use_cases: insulating wide-span industrial roof structures requiring higher tear resistance and thermal performance
commercial wall cladding assemblies needing durable double-sided foil insulation
not_for: breathable open cavity walls needing Class 4 vapour permeability
direct exposure to weather without external roof/wall cladding
retrieval.rag_summary: Kingspan AIR-CELL Retroshield XL was an upgraded commercial variant featuring a cross-linked closed-cell foam core sandwiched between plain reflective aluminium foil facings on both sides. Formulated to offer higher thermal buffering and enhanced structural durability compared to standard bubble core insulation, it served large-span commercial roofs, warehouses, and industrial wall envelopes. Formerly CodeMark certified under certificate CM20001, it has since been superseded in Kingspan's contemporary product portfolio.
